scope: Conditional likelihood recovery and resource profiling on synthetic designs. Qualifying observation availability, lap controls, finishing-order panel and completion exposure windows are fixed design variables. New responses are drawn from the joint prior. This is not end-to-end weekend calibration.
stopping: Process every named study, including after an earlier convergence failure. Only the fixed retry ladder may retry a convergence failure. Preserve failures and do not change settings, priors, seeds, cutoffs or diagnostics to rescue them. A source correction invalidates reuse and requires a recorded amendment. Do not silently redraw nonfinite prior simulations.

acceptance.criterion: All declared numerical studies are accounted for; report convergence and precision as measured. Full recovery and calibration require the separate complete inventory and registration before real-data fitting.
